compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: The pre-existing period. It is tempting to say twelve months because almost everything else in this book is 12/12 - the brochure literally prints 'for a continuous period of months' with the figure missing. Also: describing the plan as Limited Medical because that is how the NEO catalogue categorises it. It is fixed indemnity, and the carrier says so.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not state a pre-existing period. Do not call it limited medical or major medical. Do not say there is no waiting period. Do not tell a client they can cancel and come back - Everest bars re-enrollment for six months.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: This is fixed indemnity insurance. It pays you a set dollar amount for each covered service regardless of what the care costs, and the amount is the same whichever doctor or hospital you use. There is a pre-existing condition limitation and a waiting period - I need to get you the exact periods from the schedule before you decide.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Pinnacle Protect is FIXED INDEMNITY insurance underwritten by Everest Reinsurance Company. There are no network requirements and the benefit does not change by provider. A pre-existing condition limitation and a waiting period both exist but their LENGTHS are not stated in the brochure - it defers to a Schedule of Benefits that is not held. Coverage terminates at the end of the month the insured turns 65, and a member who cancels cannot re-enroll with Everest for six months. Critical Illness pays $20,000 on all three plans after a 30-day waiting period.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Obtain the PART II Schedule of Benefits. See G-059. This closes G-022 and resolves C-011.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: The monthly cost quoted on a recorded call must include this fee, or the fee must be stated separately before the payment authorisation. Quoting the product page price alone understates what the client will be charged.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A 3.5% credit-card or ACH processing fee applies to every payment and appears only in the platform TERMS panel, which more than half the product pages do not display at all.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client a scheduled benefit amount will be paid in full without qualifying it by the URC limit.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A platform-level usual, reasonable and customary cap applies on top of every product's stated benefits and appears only in the TERMS panel.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Every recorded verification must cover all four elements. Omitting the recurring monthly amount or the automatic draft is a breach of the platform agreement, not only a compliance risk.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The platform agreement requires an electronic signature or a recorded verification script with every sale, and specifies the four things the member must be shown to understand: the product, its benefits, the initial payment, and the recurring monthly amount drafted automatically.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose to any client on a tight account that a single failed draft can end the plan.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: A dishonoured payment can result in forfeiture of the plan with no liability on anyone's part, expressly including where the dishonour was inadvertent or without cause.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never describe NEO as the insurance company. Name the carrier for the specific product.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Neo Insurance Solutions is an agency and platform, not the insurer, and disclaims liability for agents' conduct and representations.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Disclose the 3.5% card/ACH processing fee on every sale regardless of which page the client was shown. Do not rely on the panel a given product page happens to display.

compliance_risks.verified_fact: Four different NEO enrolment agreements are in simultaneous circulation on the storefront, and most product pages show none at all.

network.v: 'There are NO NETWORK REQUIREMENTS for Pinnacle Protect fixed indemnity - members may use the providers and facilities of their choice. THE PLAN BENEFITS DO NOT CHANGE REGARDLESS OF PROVIDER OR FACILITY. However, members may be able to decrease their out-of-pocket costs by utilizing a participating provider in the PHCS Practitioner & Ancillary Only network.' PHCS Practitioner & Ancillary Only: 915,000 contracted healthcare providers, 60 million consumers accessing the network, 135 million medical bills processed for cost reductions. Provider lookup at https://providersearch.multiplan.com - choose the network 'PHCS Practitioner & Ancillary' and click 'Select & Search'.

product_type.v: FIXED INDEMNITY. The brochure is titled 'PINNACLE PROTECT FIXED INDEMNITY INSURANCE PLANS - An Everest Product' and explains: 'Fixed indemnity health insurance is a type of medical insurance that pays a pre-determined amount on a per-period or per-incident basis, REGARDLESS OF THE TOTAL CHARGES INCURRED. Payouts are the same no matter what the cost of care actually is... There is no deductible, coinsurance, or co payment applicable to benefits the fixed indemnity plan covers. The reimbursement rate is fixed and typically sent to the insured and not to the provider of service.'

excluded_services.v: WHAT IS NOT COVERED: Breast surgery (capsular contraction, augmentation or reduction mammoplasty) except post-mastectomy reconstruction for cancer treatment, including the other breast for symmetry and lymphedema treatment; services from persons who do not normally charge; COSMETIC SURGERY except reconstructive after trauma, infection or disease, or for a Dependent Child's congenital condition causing a functional defect; DENTAL CARE except accidental injury to Sound Natural Teeth within 12 months of a Covered Accident and congenital disease or anomaly ('Sound Natural Teeth means teeth that are free of active or chronic clinical decay, have at least 50% bone support and are functional in the arch'); ELECTIVE TREATMENT OR SURGERY; EXPERIMENTAL OR INVESTIGATIONAL treatment; treatment from a Family Member; FOREIGN TRAVEL - nothing outside the United States 'unless the charges are incurred while traveling on business or for pleasure, FOR A PERIOD NOT TO EXCEED 30 DAYS, and the charges are incurred for an EMERGENCY, provided the treatment... [is] approved for use in the United States'; EXTREME SPORTS (scuba diving, skydiving, hang-gliding, parachuting, para-gliding, para-sending, bungee jumping, mountaineering or rock climbing normally requiring guides or ropes, caving, non-scheduled flight, acting or training as pilot or crew, rodeo, acrobatic or off-road vehicle use, parkour, free running); GENDER-related treatment including sex transformation, gender dysphoric disorder, gender reassignment and treatment of sexual function; HAZARDOUS ACTIVITY OCCUPATION where compensation in any form is received; ILLEGAL ACTS; INCARCERATION; INTOXICATION (conclusively deemed if blood level exceeds the state's presumption for operating a motor vehicle, 'regardless of whether he or she is in fact operating a motor vehicle'); NOT MEDICALLY NECESSARY; MENTAL ILLNESS AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE 'whether organic or non-organic, chemical or non-chemical, biological or non-biological in origin and irrespective of cause' except where a Mental Health or Substance Abuse benefit is listed; NARCOTICS unless prescribed; OVERDOSE; PREGNANCY, maternity, childbirth and voluntary or elective abortion except where life would be endangered, and except a Newborn Indemnity Benefit if listed - 'COMPLICATIONS OF PREGNANCY ARE COVERED AS ANY OTHER SICKNESS'; military action in active armed service; MANIPULATIONS OF THE MUSCULOSKELETAL SYSTEM OR ACUPUNCTURE, including Meridian therapy; SPORTS - intercollegiate, interscholastic, organized competitive (travel or club) or professional athletics, 'This does not include dependent children participating in local recreational community sports activities'; SUICIDE OR INTENTIONAL INJURY 'even if the Covered Person did not intend to cause the harm'; UNLICENSED DRIVER unless holding a learner's permit and receiving instruction from a driver's education instructor; WAR, riot, insurrection or armed forces service - terrorism not excluded unless the covered person committed it; WEIGHT - anything for controlling weight or related to obesity or morbid obesity 'whether or not weight reduction is Medically Necessary', including gastric bypass, suction lipectomy, physical fitness programs, exercise equipment or therapy, health club membership and NUTRITIONAL COUNSELING; WORKERS COMPENSATION - anything arising out of work for wage or profit or eligible under workers' compensation 'EVEN WHEN THE COVERED PERSON DOES NOT FILE A CLAIM FOR BENEFITS'.

pre_existing.v: 'Pre-existing Condition Limitation - No benefits are payable for a Pre-Existing Condition for a continuous period of ___ months, AS OUTLINED IN PART II - SCHEDULE OF BENEFITS, following the effective date of a Covered Person's coverage under the Certificate. This exclusion does not apply to a newborn child or newborn adopted child who is added to coverage in accordance with PART II - ELIGIBILITY AND EFFECTIVE DATE OF INSURANCE.'

waiting_period_other.v: 'Waiting Period - A Covered Person must complete a Waiting Period before becoming eligible for certain benefits. A Waiting Period is the consecutive period of days from the Covered Person's Effective Date in which a Covered Person must be covered under this Certificate before benefits are payable. IF A COVERED PERSON IS DIAGNOSED WITH AN APPLICABLE MEDICAL CONDITION PRIOR TO COMPLETING A WAITING PERIOD, NO BENEFITS ARE PAYABLE. This provision does not apply to any Newborn Child or Adopted Children... Any applicable Waiting Period will be shown in PART II - SCHEDULE OF BENEFITS.' The benefit grid separately states a 30 DAY WAITING PERIOD on the Critical Illness benefit.
